title: Quick Roasted Polish Meat Kebabs
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring roasted meat kebabs with a blend of spices and a hint of yuzu, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. This recipe is sugar-free friendly and can be a great hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together pul biber, yuzu juice, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork shoulder and onion to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the pork and onion onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the kebabs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as roasted vegetables or mashed potatoes.
